text: [[public-op-named-as-its-external-serves-every-row]]: fixed on bleeding (PR 29). An op named like an entity served every row with none of its filter. Released 0.5.1 has the fault; no app in the repo, notes v2 included, has such a name. The fix ships with 0.5.2. Still open before main: [[identity-app-origins-trusted-as-clients]], being fixed now, and [[two-ops-of-one-name-replace-silently]], queued. [[example-apps-notes-v2-plus-note_viewer]] is built on bleeding. 0.5.2 waits for PR 13 (held).
